hero.name: Pedro Suárez Gallardo
hero.pitch: I build the web products teams rely on: real-time, data-heavy and made to run in production.

about.statement: I build the parts that are hard to get right.

paragraphs.problem: Large data sets, live updates, complex forms, and state people can rely on. That is the work teams trust me with—and the work I enjoy most.
paragraphs.experience: I have more than three years of professional experience building and maintaining production web apps with React and TypeScript. I also work on the backend, building REST APIs in several languages and refactoring for speed and clarity.
paragraphs.approach: I understand the problem before I touch it, care about the details, and deliver software that stays maintainable. I use AI tools such as Copilot every day to move faster, and I always review what they produce.
paragraphs.background: I moved into web development through an intensive bootcamp and keep learning. Spanish is my native language.

desktopAppsToWeb.title: Desktop apps, moved to the web.
desktopAppsToWeb.result: I migrated two contact-center applications and redesigned their multilanguage interface. Both are in production and actively maintained.

liveSupervisionDashboard.title: A real-time supervision dashboard.
liveSupervisionDashboard.result: Tracks agent activity live, with customizable views and charts over hundreds of thousands of records.

adminSuite.title: An admin suite with dozens of sections.
adminSuite.result: Custom reporting, plus complex forms and tables with advanced validation.

visualFlowEditor.title: A visual flow editor.
visualFlowEditor.result: A workflow system for chatbots and voice menus (IVR), plus the frontend of a real-time live chat.

integrationsAndBackendApis.title: Integrations and backend APIs.
integrationsAndBackendApis.result: Messaging and CRM integrations through REST APIs and third-party SDKs, REST APIs in Node.js (Express), C# and PHP, Python automation, and backend refactors for speed and clarity.
